0x0007FC.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00086D.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008F5.en: 「Dammit!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000A1E.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A56.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B1F.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000B5A.en: 「No way I'm blowing it here...!@　This ain't funny...」

0x000BAE.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CFF.en: 「This is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D31.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000DAB.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DF8.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. Leave the rest to you.」

0x000E36.en: 「Eek, I'll leave the rest to you all!」

0x000E7D.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F28.en: 「Ngh... so I become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x000FDF.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x001020.en: 「Oh myyy, they done got me good!」

0x0010D1.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001118.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x00114D.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x00120A.en: 「Kh... You're as good as they say.」

0x001239.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x001287.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001342.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001371.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013AF.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013DE.en: 「I can't go on any further. Please excuse me.」

0x001469.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001921.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Langran State, Mt. Gazetta

0x0019C1.en: 「Then Lt. Viletta, Masaki and I@ will go meet with Prince Feil-Lord.」

0x001A2F.en: 「All hands, remain at Combat Condition Two.@ Maintain strict air and ground watch.」

0x001A9E.en: 「...Well, well. We finally get to meet the Prince.」

0x001ADB.en: 「Masaki, well done. And to all of you from@ the surface as well, I'm deeply grateful@ for your efforts.」

0x001B62.en: 「Forgive my discourtesy over the comms until now.@ To at last look upon Your Highness's face...」

0x001BCA.en: 「Ah, no, please, at ease. I'm not fond of@ formality myself.」

0x001C3B.en: 「Then, Your Highness...@ there are a few things I'd like to ask,@ if I may?」

0x001CCF.en: 「Is there anything you've learned about@ the cause of the surface-dweller summonings?」

0x001D2E.en: 「...That remains under investigation.@ However, the Gates appearing in various@ places do seem to be settling down.」

0x001DCD.en: 「Then do you know anything of the Hiryu Kai,@ flagship of the Steel Dragon Squadron, which@ may have come to this world, or of its crew?」

0x001E8A.en: 「We've gained no information on that either...@ With the Shutedonias army to deal with, we@ can't mount a proper search, and it pains me.」

0x001F41.en: 「...I believe I understand Langran's situation.@ But we have our own duties on the surface, and@ we can't remain here indefinitely...」

0x001FFB.en: 「I understand.@ Once things settle, we'll search for your@ comrades and prepare your return to the surface.」

0x00208B.en: (Just as Masaki said, there seem to be ways@ back to the surface besides Solatis Temple...)

0x00211A.en: 「Either way, until we know the fate of the@ Hiryu Kai and our subordinates, we can't@ return to the surface.」

0x0021A7.en: 「Besides, forces hostile to us have also been@ summoned to this world...@ We'll continue to lend Your Highness our aid.」

0x002246.en: 「That's most welcome. May I take it you're@ placing your trust in me?」

0x0022B7.en: 「Yes.@ One reason is that Masaki, who fought@ alongside us on the surface, serves under you.」

0x00233B.en: 「Wh-when you put it that way, it's kind of embarrassing.」

0x00236F.en: 「...Then, Lt. Colonel, I'd like you and your@ people to join the war council for retaking the capital.」

0x002434.en: 「Of course. You've slacked off plenty until@ now, but not this time.@ You're a pilot of the Elemental Lords, after all.」

0x0024E5.en: 「Tch... The Hagane's fine, but these@ councils are so stiff and formal.」

0x002547.en: 「...The way you say that makes it sound like@ we run our briefings all chummy and relaxed?」

0x0025D9.en: 「Ah, no, that's not what I meant.」

0x002610.en: 「The Elemental Lords are the core of our@ strength. Masaki, I want you at the council too.」

0x002675.en: 「Though, as I've said before... I'll ask for the@ Lord pilots' cooperation, but I'll never force it.」

0x0026F5.en: 「All right, I'll go. My own choice, of course.」

0x00273B.en: (Even Masaki turns honest in front of@ Prince Feil-Lord, it seems...)

0x0027CB.en: 「...I see. So we're settled on staying in@ <La Gias> a while longer, then.」

0x002848.en: 「Yeah. Getting something as big as the Hagane@ back to the surface takes plenty of prep@ and time, apparently.」

0x0028CF.en: 「I wonder how it was when we got summoned here.」

0x002915.en: 「...If I recall, Masaki and Tytti were called@ to <La Gias> as candidate pilots for the@ Elemental Lords, right?」

0x0029B3.en: 「Yeah, in my case I came to Langran with just the clothes on my back.」

0x0029F3.en: 「But this time it's everything from a warship@ down to Mio - the summon conditions and spots@ are all over the place.」

0x002A70.en: 「Even if someone set it up...@ you could call this an accident, couldn't you?」

0x002AEA.en: 「That view came up on our side as well.」

0x002B24.en: 「So even if someone plotted the surface-dweller@ summonings... this outcome caught them off guard too?」

0x002BC6.en: 「Even if they meant to fold people like us into@ their forces, if they couldn't know who got@ summoned where...」

0x002C9C.en: 「Either way, I want to find Kyosuke, the boss,@ and Ryusei and the others soon.」

0x002D11.en: 「You're right...@ And by now, our disappearance might have@ caused an uproar back on the surface.」

0x002DAA.en: 「If we could, I'd like to get word to them.@ Though explaining it all would be a pain.」

0x002E1B.en: 「Hey, Masaki. Is there a way to contact the surface?」

0x002E61.en: 「We could use an Aether transceiver, but@ there's no receiver on the other side...」

0x002EC6.en: 「I've wondered for a while, but if the@ Cybuster can freely travel between the@ surface and La Gias...」

0x002F53.en: 「True, but the field it generates passing@ through a Gate is small.」

0x002FB8.en: 「Maybe one Personal Trooper's worth could@ be gripped in the Cybird's talons and slip@ through the Gate along with it, but...」

0x003075.en: 「Still, you can't exactly head up to the@ surface right now, can you.」

0x0030CE.en: 「...The members joining the operation are all here.」

0x003111.en: 「Then I'll brief you on the plan to retake the@ capital. By Prince Feil-Lord's wishes, we'll@ act as a separate unit and draw the enemy off.」

0x0031AD.en: 「First, we hit the capital's rear from the west@ and draw off the Shutedonias army.@ That's the Prince's chance to storm the capital.」

0x003273.en: 「Note, the enemy sees us as an irregular@ element. They can't ignore us. Move around@ as flashily as you possibly can.」

0x003358.en: 「Last time we tripped up thanks to Shu, but@ this time we'll reach the capital for sure and@ kick the Shutedonias bunch out...!」

0x0033FD.en: 「Commencing the diversion.@ Fore main guns, all sub-guns, VSLM, ready to fire!」

0x003478.en: 「So they came our way after all.@ Just as we intended.」

0x0034C8.en: 「Guess your hunches pay off once in a while.@ But those guys are a real handful, honestly.@ On top of that, the Zamzeed got stolen too.」

0x003588.en: 「This time I've prepared a trump card.@ There's no need to worry.」

0x0035DB.en: 「Ho, that's news to me. What's this trump card?」

0x003618.en: 「That, even to you, General Jesuha, I@ cannot say. It's my unit's privilege.」

0x003692.en: 「Tch, how irritating. This is exactly why I@ can't stand you special ops types.」

0x00372E.en: 「Well, whatever.@ Point is, that surface-dweller unit is trouble.@ We've got to do something about it.」

0x0037CE.en: 「I know, I know.@ Right now I'm little more than a freeloader.@ I'll take your orders, and the glory's yours too.」

0x003867.en: (Hmph... You're past your prime, General Jesuha.)

0x0038CF.en: 「...Hmph, not bad.@ But we hold a trump card.」

0x003928.en: 「Attention, surface-dwellers. Disarm and surrender at once!」

0x0039A5.en: 「If you don't obey our command,@ Princess Monica will pay the price.@ Is that what you want?」

0x003A48.en: 「Don't tell me they've taken Princess Monica hostage!?」

0x003B64.en: 「Say what you like.@ We simply don't want to spill any more needless blood.」

0x003BC9.en: 「Don't screw with us!@ You're the ones who invaded Langran!」

0x003C22.en: 「Listen, kid, we've got our own reasons@ for what we do.」

0x003C84.en: 「A bunch that stoops to taking hostages@ has no right to talk!」

0x003D0E.en: 「If you claim you've taken the Princess hostage,@ then show us proof.」

0x003D6D.en: 「Very well.@ ...You there, bring Princess Monica here.」

0x003DC0.en: 「...What!? What's the meaning of this!?@ What have you fools been doing!?」

0x003E5A.en: 「...The situation's changed.@ If you value the hostage's life, withdraw at once.」

0x003EC2.en: 「What are you talking about...@ Is Princess Monica really there?」

0x003FCD.en: 「Everyone, Princess Monica's in that Elemental Lord!@ Cover me!」

0x00402C.en: 「Ah, hold on a sec.@ Honestly, dressing me up like this...」

0x0040F1.en: 「Yes, it's me.@ Since they lost Monica, they were going@ to use me as a stand-in.」

0x0041E7.en: 「Sorry to ask, Masaki... but could you cover me?」

0x00424F.en: 「No point now that the cover's blown.@　Besides, taking hostages ain't my style.」

0x0042CF.en: 「The operation hasn't failed yet!@　Take back the princess and drive them off!」

0x00433A.en: 「Grr, not again! Retreat, all units retreat!」

0x004380.en: 「...So that's phase one of the@　diversion done, I suppose?」

0x0043D9.en: 「But that can't be all the Shutedonias troops@　in this area.@　We can't let our guard down yet.」

0x004478.en: 「Azuki, signal all units.@　Return to ship at once for resupply and repairs.」

0x0044E1.en: 「We'll hold this position for a while.@　Stay sharp for air and ground threats.」

0x00453A.en: 「Tch! No help for it, we're pulling out!@　A demotion's a lock, but it beats dyin'!」

0x0045BA.en: 「First the Zamzeed, now Xenia too!@　This is gonna cost me!」

0x004613.en: 「Hey now! @　I got nothin' to do with the princess business!」

0x004663.en: 「What, the little lady from last time?@　Fightin' kids just don't sit right with me.」

0x0046CE.en: （Maybe he's not such a bad guy after all?）

0x004702.en: 「You coward! How dare you pull that!」

0x004739.en: 「This is war! All that matters is winning!」

0x004782.en: 「Taking hostages, and not once but twice...@　You should be ashamed!」

0x0047DB.en: 「We'll do whatever it takes to get the job done!」

0x004837.en: 「I finally got out. I'm not going down here!」

0x0048B2.en: 「I never dreamed the day would come@　that I'd ride the Hagane.@　Seeing surface mecha with my own eyes... I'm thrilled...」

0x00494E.en: 「Same as ever, Xenia.@　By the way, how's the Zamzeed?@　Can you fix it?」

0x0049C0.en: 「The armor's self-repair is coming along,@　and some patchwork should get it running.」

0x004A2E.en: 「...Say, Martha.@　Would you introduce me to the princess?」

0x004A87.en: 「Sure. This is Princess Xenia Grania Bilseia.@ Lord Feil's younger sister, and Princess Monica's older twin.」

0x004B19.en: 「Nice to meet you. I've no claim to the throne,@　so just call me Xenia, no need to be formal.」

0x004BC4.en: 「Basically, I'm a washout.@　I failed the magic test.」

0x004C36.en: 「Magic comes from channeling <Plana>@ a strong force of will people project... um...@ basically, it's like your psychic power.」

0x004D07.en: 「All royals take the magic test, and if you@　don't pass, you're denied any claim to the throne.」

0x004D99.en: 「S-sounds rough, being a princess or prince here...」

0x004DE2.en: 「So, Lady Xenia...@　why did you stand in for Lady Monica?」

0x004E38.en: 「Oh, right. They let Monica get@　carried off by Christoph.」
